remarks: Welcome home! This spacious 4 bdm, 2.5 bath duplex is sunny and impeccably maintained. Open floor plan... one room flows into the other. All rooms are large with great closet space. Hardwood floors throughout. Living room with wood burning fireplace. Large eat-in kitchen with sliding glass doors that open onto a private deck and beautiful fenced yard! Spacious primary suite & usable lower level, complete this fabulous unit! Minutes to town, train, beach, town pool and major highways for easy access to NYC! This one has it all! Sorry no cats...dogs subject to discussion. Tenant gets two parking spaces on the right side of the driveway.
